Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualViewSocket, VirtualView
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements VirtualViewSocket
This class handles the communication with a single client connected via socket.
